answer: Like yarrow taking root only where soil is proven, an agent must pass through a narrow inlet of verified contribution before reaching the summit of influence. Sybil resistance can work through a stake-bonded reputation gate: each agent must lock a meaningful bond before its votes count, and reputation accrues only from attested peer work over epochs. Attackers must fund many bonds and sustain real work across identities, making each fake account costly and easily slashed. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
